verdict.rationale: Docs describe real-time automatic revocation of access and updates to permissions/groups when someone leaves, plus device retrieval flows triggered instantly on offboarding, which together support the 'one action' offboarding story. However, evidence doesn't explicitly confirm session-kill immediacy or a unified single-click offboarding action, nor independent/hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit session-termination confirmation, independent/hands-on verification of the offboarding flow, detail on which 'connected apps' are deprovisioned via SCIM in practice.
